title: Ad-hoc pricing concessions runbook with audit and allocation guidelines
creator: Alejandro Ruiz
description: Create an operational runbook and lightweight decision framework for handling ad-hoc pricing concessions, one-off marketplace credits, and invoice allocation exceptions for enterprise customers. The goal is to reduce RTT for finance/solutions requests, ensure consistent accounting/ledger treatment, preserve auditability, and define clear escalation and approval boundaries. This ticket covers scope, approval matrix, ledger mapping (SKU/taxonomy), templated invoice/credit memo language, instrumentation to trace concessions end-to-end, and SLOs for turnaround.
acceptance_criteria: Defined approval matrix (roles + thresholds) documented and signed off by Finance and Legal
SKU-to-ledger mapping table and invoice allocation rules published in Confluence with examples
Two templated artifacts: invoice addendum and credit memo template available in Drive
End-to-end tracing established: Linear ticket -> GH PR -> Billing ledger entry -> invoice/credit ID, with dashboard tile showing time-to-resolution
tasks: Draft approval matrix and escalation flow with Finance (owner: PM)
Create SKU mapping CSV and sample allocations for the top 10 enterprise plans (owner: Eng/Finance)
Write templated invoice addendum and credit memo language (owner: PM/Legal)
Instrument events in billing pipeline for concession origin & allocation tags (owner: Eng)
Ship a lightweight dashboard card in Console to surface active concessions older than 7 days (owner: Analytics)
Run tabletop with Solutions and Support to validate process on 3 historical cases (owner: PM)
Publish runbook and announce to GTM and Support orgs (owner: PM)
Define metrics and set alerting (time-to-decision >72h) (owner: Reliability)
